heading: Complaint to Ombudsman regarding harassment or illegal deprivation of property
title: Complaint to Ombudsman regarding harassment or illegal deprivation of property
text: (1) Any woman who is deprived of ownership or possession of her property, by any person through fraud, coercion, force or any illegal means, may file a complaint to the Ombudsman: Provided that the Ombudsman shall decide the complaint within sixty days from receipt thereof.
text_raw: (1) Any woman who is deprived of ownership or possession of her property, by any person through fraud, coercion, force or any illegal means, may file a complaint to the Ombudsman: Provided that the Ombudsman shall decide the complaint within sixty days from receipt thereof.

heading: Delivery of possession by Ombudsman through police / local administration
title: Delivery of possession by Ombudsman through police / local administration
text: (1) The Ombudsman may, on finding that a woman has been illegally deprived of possession of her property, direct the Deputy Commissioner or local administration to restore possession of the property to the complainant.
text_raw: (1) The Ombudsman may, on finding that a woman has been illegally deprived of possession of her property, direct the Deputy Commissioner or local administration to restore possession of the property to the complainant.
